mod.base.name: Base Game
era.ancient.name: Ancient Era
era.ancient.desc: The age of river valleys and the first cities, when kingdoms were built on irrigated grain, organized labor and monumental construction.
era.colonial.name: Colonial Era
era.colonial.desc: Three centuries of settlement, trade and conflict, as colonies, ports and native nations reshaped the lands around them.
era.modern.name: Modern Era
era.modern.desc: The industrial city of the early twentieth century, with its railways, factories, crowded neighborhoods and rapidly growing populations.
era.utopian.name: Utopian Era
era.utopian.desc: From the present day to 2100 and beyond: humanity's future, utopian or otherwise.
